notes.title: Songs of Armageddopolis Update
notes.notes:
Game Achievements show that most players quit the game after a few trial levels. Perhaps the reason for this is the controls. Avoiding all the obstacles with a mouse can be a bit cumbersome. Therefore, we now support controllers. Please remember to switch the controller layout from mouse to controller via Steam.
Additionally, I have added new tracks and fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Songs of Armageddopolis Patch 1
Armageddopolis comes... but not today
notes.notes: We postpone release of the game because we want to provide better experience for our players. We polish some mechanics and improve English translation.
